data.one_liner: Add gesture callbacks and interactivity to shapes drawn inside a Flutter CustomPainter canvas.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a CustomPaint widget and provides a TouchyCanvas that tracks shape dimensions, painting styles, stroke widths, and clipping regions. When a user interacts with the canvas, it automatically detects which shape was touched and fires the corresponding callback.
use_when: You are building custom drawings using a CustomPainter and need touch interactions for individual shapes
You want to handle tap, pan, or other gesture events on custom canvas drawings easily
avoid_when: You are building standard UI layouts where standard Flutter widgets like GestureDetector and containers suffice
You need advanced touch detection on complex vertices that are not yet supported by the roadmap
strengths: Supports multiple gesture callbacks per shape
Automatically handles paint style, stroke width, and clipping modes
Simple and intuitive API utilizing CanvasTouchDetector and TouchyCanvas
weaknesses: Custom Path hit testing is currently limited to opaque hit test behavior
Missing support for translation, rotation, scaling, and skewing transformations
Not running touch detection in a separate isolate yet
data.setup_notes: No native configuration or build_runner required; just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
